class.name: OcgShapeupgradeShapedivide
class.brief_description: Divides a all faces in shell with given criteria Shell.
class.description: ! Divides a all faces in shell with given criteria Shell.

method.name: SetPrecision
method.description: Defines the spatial precision used for splitting

method.name: SetSurfaceSegmentMode
method.description: Purpose sets mode for trimming (segment) surface by wire UV bounds.

method.name: Perform
method.description: Performs splitting and computes the resulting shape If newContext is True (default), the internal context will be cleared at start, else previous substitutions will be acting.

method.name: Result
method.description: Gives the resulting Shape, or Null shape if not done.

method.name: GetContext
method.description: Returns context with all the modifications made during last call(s) to Perform() recorded

method.name: SetContext
method.description: Sets context with recorded modifications to be applied during next call(s) to Perform(shape,Standard_False)

method.name: SendMsg
method.description: Sends a message to be attached to the shape. Calls corresponding message of message registrator.

method.name: Status
method.description: Queries the status of last call to Perform OK : no splitting was done (or no call to Perform) DONE1: some edges were split DONE2: surface was split FAIL1: some errors occurred

method.name: SetSplitFaceTool
method.description: Sets the tool for splitting faces.

method.name: SetEdgeMode
method.description: Sets mode for splitting 3d curves from edges. 0 - only curve 3d from free edges. 1 - only curve 3d from shared edges. 2 - all curve 3d.
